test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a question followed by two statements I and II. Read both statements carefully to decide which one of them is sufficient to answer the question

Six people - K, M, N, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Who sits second to the left of P?

(I) K sits to the immediate right of P. Only two people sit between P and Q. R sits second to the right of M.

(II) Only two people sit between N and M. Q is an immediate neighbour of M. Only one person sits between Q and K.

options.text: Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
Data in statements I and II together are NOT sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.

solution:
Given : 

 
• Six people - K, M, N, P, Q and R
 
• All of them are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Explanation :

 
• Statement - (I) : K sits to the immediate right of P. Only two people sit between P and Q. R sits second to the right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e228aee62d4e7abedb694e0616f271e471a4982e45d7aa8cebd81d7ad5e59fb3.png] 

**Here, R sits second to the left of P. **

 
• Statement - (II) : Only two people sit between N and M. Q is an immediate neighbour of M. Only one person sits between Q and K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cec62803f94eb74afb61eb9eab25f4e28bfda6bfd2051961010bde53928f0ee1.png] 

Here, position of P cannot be determined, therefore who **sits second to the left of P** cannot be answered. 

**Therefore, Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.**

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
